meta.routeTitle: Walking to Mordor — Frodo & Sam's Route (Ring-bearer only)
meta.secondarySource: Karen Wynn Fonstad, Atlas of Middle-earth
meta.coverage: Hobbiton to Weathertop only. Later legs (Weathertop to Rivendell onward) not yet transcribed.
meta.notes: Cumulative mileages are best estimates reconstructed from Strachey's day-by-day commentary, which itself is often approximate ('some miles', 'a mile or two') since Tolkien's original text rarely gives exact distances. Where Strachey flags her own uncertainty or an internal discrepancy in the source text, that is preserved in the 'confidence' and 'note' fields rather than smoothed over. This file should be checked against the physical book before being treated as final.

waypoints.name: Hobbiton (Bag End)
waypoints.note: Starting point. Journey begins the evening of 23 Sept.

waypoints.name: Birch grove camp, Green Hill Country
waypoints.note: Left Hobbiton soon after sunset (~7pm), walked 'for about three hours' before making camp under birches. Strachey reckons 14-15 miles that first evening; midpoint used.

waypoints.name: Greensward above Stockbrook, Woody End
waypoints.note: A long, strenuous day delayed by hiding from the Black Rider. Strachey estimates 'more than 20 miles in all'; 21 used as a conservative round figure. Camp was on a steep bluff overlooking the Stockbrook.

waypoints.name: The Ferry (River Baranduin crossing)
waypoints.note: Frodo cut cross-country toward the Ferry, a point Strachey places 18 miles south-east of the Shire in a straight line (more precisely ESE). This is a straight-line figure, not the actual walked path length via Maggot's Farm, so the true distance covered was almost certainly higher. Flagged for correction once transcribed from the book directly.
waypoints.sourceSection: §5 Maggot's Farm; §6 Brandywine Bridge to Bree

waypoints.name: Crickhollow
waypoints.note: After crossing the Ferry: passed Buck Hill and Brandy Hall, went north about half a mile along the main road, then turned off through a hedge-gate to Crickhollow. Short final leg of the day.

waypoints.name: Tunnel Gate (edge of the Old Forest)
waypoints.note: Morning ride from Crickhollow through the spinney and along the Hedge to the Tunnel Gate — 'about an hour' at a slow pace, reckoned as 4-5 miles.

waypoints.name: Tom Bombadil's House
waypoints.note: Through the Old Forest, misled by its influence, drifting south and east down to the Withywindle before reaching the house. On foot hobbits can't exceed ~24 miles/day; on ponies they should have managed 30-35, but forest difficulties likely limited them to ~25. Strachey's own figure is approximate.

waypoints.name: Barrow (captured by Barrow-wight)
waypoints.note: 27 Sept was a rest day at Bombadil's house (not counted as travel). On 28 Sept the party wandered lost in fog on the Barrow-downs, net forward progress is effectively unclear/circular — no net mileage assigned pending closer transcription.

waypoints.name: Road at the northern gap, en route to Bree
waypoints.note: Tom Bombadil led them from the Barrow rescue west then north to the northern gap and onto the road. Strachey states they were 'about four miles from Bree' at the point they parted from Tom.

waypoints.name: Bree (The Prancing Pony)
waypoints.note: Arrived at dusk. This closes out the Shire-to-Bree leg.

waypoints.name: Chetwood exit / Midgewater Marshes entry
waypoints.note: Covers 30 Sept and 1 Oct combined: departed Bree, looped through the Chetwood (a longer path than straight-line due to the loop shape). Distance derived from the Chetwood/Weathertop map's own coordinate grid and printed mile scale, NOT transcribed from prose text, since Strachey's own day-count narrative is internally inconsistent here (see note on id 14). Needs verification against the physical map's scale bar with a ruler.

waypoints.name: Midgewater Marshes, night 2
waypoints.note: Relatively straight stretch through the marshes per the map's route line.

waypoints.name: Midgewater Marshes, night 3
waypoints.note: Continuing east through the marshes, still avoiding the impassable ground further south.

waypoints.name: Approach to the Weather Hills
waypoints.note: Route bends north on the map here, closing in on Weathertop.

waypoints.name: Weathertop (attacked)
waypoints.note: Strachey explicitly flags a discrepancy in the source text here: Aragorn's statement that Weathertop is 'halfway' to Rivendell doesn't reconcile cleanly with the stated 14-day Bree-to-Ford journey (normally ~12 days), implying either a longer route or a slip in the original text. Rather than resolve that prose contradiction, this and the four preceding waypoints (ids 10-13) were derived instead from the Chetwood/Weathertop map's own printed grid and mile scale, giving an independent ~95-mile Bree-to-Weathertop total. This was estimated from the map's visual proportions as shared in conversation, not a precise pixel/ruler measurement, so treat as provisional pending direct verification against the physical map.
